entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We haven't gotten a chance to spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "We haven't gotten a chance to speak since Her Highness' engagement."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Vina didn't tell me the full exten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina didn't tell me the full extent of your conversation. But from what I gather, she had no say in the matter whatsoever."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I have to say, I was shocked that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say, I was shocked that you would do such a thing to your own daughter."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Vina didn't tell me the full exten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina didn't tell me the full extent of your conversation. But from what I gather, this was necessary for the sake of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I also have a sneaking suspicion t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also have a sneaking suspicion that more went on between them in Pales than Her Highness was willing to admit at the time."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""At any rate... it goes without say..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate... it goes without saying that my family is disappointed. But I don't want this to affect our professional relationship."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We haven't gotten a chance to spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "We haven't gotten a chance to speak since you refused to allow Her Highness and myself to marry."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Her Highness assured me that you g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Highness assured me that you gave her a choice in the matter. All I could do was wish her and her new fiance the best of luck."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Her Highness assured me that there..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Highness assured me that there were legitimate reasons behind your decision. All I could do was wish her the best of luck in her new position."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Vina didn't tell me the full exten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina didn't tell me the full extent of your conversation. But she seemed quite shaken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina will be fine, Mr. Sazon. I ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina will be fine, Mr. Sazon. I made this decision for her own good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish things had gone differently..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish things had gone differently as well. But what's done is done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rest assured, it's nothing persona..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured, it's nothing personal. I won't let it affect our working relationship."
